design.metaDescription: Tokens, typography and components of the Origin Jumpworks site.
design.title: Line first
design.lead: One-pixel lines, plenty of space, slow motion. Every element starts as an outline, then the material appears.

colors.title: Colours
colors.intro: Two themes, the same restraint. Every text colour exceeds 4.5:1; the glow and lines are reserved for decoration. These ratios are checked by an automated test.
colors.caption: Text colour contrast, {theme} theme

type.title: Typography
type.intro: Geometric, light-weight headings with wide tracking. Body text in Inter for legibility, technical codes in JetBrains Mono.
type.sampleMd: Founded in 2747, based in New Austin since 2913
type.sampleLead: Origin Jumpworks designs ships the way one designs a luxury object: clean lines, noble materials, and elegance as a primary function.
type.sampleBody: Body text stays at regular weight, with 1.6 line height and lines capped at 65 characters, for comfortable reading in both themes.

components.title: Components
components.intro: 45° cut corners, one-pixel outlines, no bounce. Outlines are drawn with clipped layers so the focus ring is never cut off.
components.linkSentence: An internal link to the <internal>home page</internal> and an external link to <external>starcitizen.tools</external>.
components.frameText: One-pixel outline, cut corners, optional corner marks.

example.title: In context
example.intro: Image from the data harvest (AVIF then WebP, blurred preview while loading) and a spec sheet with static values.

motion.title: Motion
motion.intro: Slow, eased, never jerky. Only one thing moves strongly at a time. Everything is disabled when the visitor asks for less motion.
